_about: The survivor's standing orders: one objective at a time, in order, shown on the HUD card. Every condition is read from state the player can already see (bag contents, bonded animals, which island you are on), so no system has to report completion. Rewards are pioneer XP and T-stones. Added 2026-09-22 after a bot playthrough found the early game had no stated goal at all.

steps.title: Gather 3 branches
steps.hint: Tap a tree and pick Branch from the wheel

steps.title: Pick up 2 stones
steps.hint: Loose rock comes up by hand

steps.title: Strip 4 plant fibre
steps.hint: Bushes and wild grass, no tool needed

steps.title: Make a work axe at the bench
steps.hint: The camp workbench, same three parts

steps.title: Fell 2 wood logs
steps.hint: The axe opens Wood Log on any tree

steps.title: Cook a skewer at the fire
steps.hint: Meat and a branch at the bonfire

steps.title: Tame a Zebraceratops
steps.hint: Wear it down, knock it over, then feed it berries

steps.title: Sail for the unstable savannah
steps.hint: The harbour at the end of the dock
